name: @vitest/browser-playwright
reason: vite-plus, at the version the catalog pins, depends on vitest 5.1.0 and its @vitest packages exactly, and asks for @vitest/browser-playwright 5.1.0 as its peer, so a newer @vitest/browser-playwright installs a second vitest beside the one vp test runs.
